transcript.text: Hey! I'm Sam. I haven't read a book in like two years and I want to get back into it, a little every day

Hey Sam, I'm ZOH! I'll help you get back into books with one small step a day. Text "stop" anytime, and tell me whenever you want me to coach differently, like "chill out" or "push me harder." Getting back after two years? Let's go. What kind of stuff do you like to read, or is there a book you've been meaning to get to?
thrillers mostly, I loved Gone Girl. what's the best one to start with?

Gone Girl fan, so you want fast and twisty. Something like The Girl on the Train by Paula Hawkins or The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides would pull you right back in. We'll lock in the pick in your plan. When in your day could you read, like a set time that's yours?
evenings after 9, like 20 to 30 min. I've got a library card

Library card is perfect, that means a free copy of The Silent Patient or Girl on the Train. Where do you want this to get you, like finishing a whole book in a couple of weeks? Totally fine if you're not sure yet.

grade.summary: ZOH avoided the two known failures: it added no invented 'at home' detail and told Sam once in its first text that it can change how it coaches. It slipped in text 2 with a plan-is-coming line ('We'll lock in the pick in your plan'), and text 3's claim that the library has free copies is a small unstated fact.
